title: New studio condo/Free parking
description:
This unique place has a style all its own and perfect for a trip to Nashville! Located Minutes from everything Nashville has to offer. If you plan on arriving in your own vehicle there is free parking onsite to accomodate you and your guests. This is a Modern Industrial styled space you will enjoy during your time in Tennessee!

The space
This is a brand new studio condo located minutes from downtown Nashville!

Industrial styled condo that feels like home!
•Smart TVs with Roku and YouTube TV
•High speed WiFi
•Full size washer and dryer inside condo
•Keurig and K-Cups
•Designated work area
•FREE parking onsite

Guest access
Guest have access to the entire unit!
